reviews.text:
We went to this clinic yesterday for our family dog. Living far away, we'd never been there before, but right from the emergency room, everyone was very helpful, even for an ultrasound. The entire team, especially Dr. Coccoli, explained everything to us with extreme determination and clarity, and was also very available afterward for updates and to decide how to proceed, given the very delicate situation.
In such critical times with our pets, it's important to meet people like this.
Highly recommended.
Competent and very good doctors, highly recommended

Dogs notoriously don't like going to the vet, but our Mojito just needs to say "Let's go say hello to Melinda" to see him wagging his tail and running toward the front door.
The expertise, professionalism, and empathy of Dr. Diotti, the cuddles from Denise, and the helpfulness of the entire staff at the Certosa Veterinary Clinic win over four-legged owners and patients!! 🐾
A super "raw slurp" from the now—and a little bit yours, too—Mojito!
Kind and prepared

I haven't slept well in months. I brought my dog ​​and best friend of almost 6 years a few months ago. I was in shock and in a precarious situation. They immediately told me to put her down due to "acute continuous evacuation." They didn't give me any support, but they still made me open a loan and a financing. They used ChatGpt as an assistant. They bombarded her with medications and gave her human medications that I still have here in the refrigerator. They made me sign various forms to protect their responsibilities. In the end, I lost her. She even called me to ask me to remove the review.

I will never stop thanking the entire staff at the veterinary clinic for the love, expertise, and dedication with which they cared for my Leon at such a delicate time.
A special thank you to Dr. Flavia Lo Cascio, who, with her great professionalism, sensitivity, and humanity, carefully guided us through every step of the journey. A heartfelt thank you also to Chiara Coccoli and Denise, always kind, helpful, and caring, making us feel welcomed and supported every day.
At this clinic, you will find not only trained professionals, but people who truly love animals and treat them as if they were their own.
Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

Exceptional professionals, this clinic is truly a safe place for us. We have two cats, one of whom is a bit peculiar and aggressive, and they always find the right way to treat him. They are super helpful and, above all, professional, but also very, very empathetic.
Just a phone call or message away, they're there for anything, even just a simple piece of advice. The vets and assistants are all truly knowledgeable, capable, helpful, professional, and extremely honest. I love my cats, and this clinic is the best choice for them. Thank you for everything you've done and continue to do for US❤️

Here at the Clinic, we met our trusted doctors, who were knowledgeable and available. They identified and resolved all of our Labrador's problems with care and attention, always demonstrating empathy and sensitivity, even towards us. Thank you!

My three cats are cared for by Dr. Chiara Coccoli, an extremely competent, knowledgeable, and meticulous professional, but also a person of great empathy and humanity. Over time, she has successfully addressed and resolved even very delicate situations, related to serious illnesses, always demonstrating great professionalism and dedication. At every step, I have felt listened to, supported, and reassured. Knowing I can count on someone like her for the care of my animals is truly a blessing. I highly recommend her to anyone looking for a capable, attentive professional who truly loves animals.

Dr. A. Pola's Certosa Veterinary Clinic has always been my go-to vet when my dog ​​Mary (and before that, my cats) needs routine checkups, or when she's not feeling well. I must say that all the staff is very kind, knowledgeable, and helpful (both with us humans and especially with our furry friends). I've even contacted them outside of their normal hours, and they always answer the chat for emergencies or sensitive situations. Thank you, because we don't know what to do in those moments, and having someone to answer makes a huge difference.

Marta Di Martino

I wanted to thank the entire clinic staff, especially Dr. Coccoli, Dr. Salis, and Dr. Diotti, who cared for my cat with such patience and compassion, always available to offer support even outside of their working hours. After several unsuccessful attempts at treatment, we finally had to undergo a urethroscopy. Despite much concern, everything went well, and my cat survived and is still here with us today. I thank the entire staff for their helpfulness, professionalism, and dedication!!!

I discovered the Clinic a few months ago because I recently moved to Q.Oggiaro. We are lovingly caring for my dachshund Egle♥️ (who is my whole life), who is now almost 16 years old and has a number of health conditions. They are helping me in every way to best care for her.
I often visit them and find them competent and kind!
Doctors and doctors!
... they are my little security.
Thank you for everything 🙏♥️🌷
Miky* + Egle♡
Good and professional

I've been taking my cats since they were kittens and have always had a great experience. The staff is kind, helpful, and very competent. The facilities are clean and well-maintained. Special thanks to Dr. Flavia, who was very kind and helpful!

My experience with them was terrible. I found them incompetent, unreliable, and confusing. When I asked why, after leaving my cat at the clinic for three and a half hours, an ultrasound and blood tests hadn't been done, I was even attacked by a very young and rather skinny vet. I was truly speechless by the lack of professionalism and behavior of the vet, who, to justify their negligence, even went so far as to assault me.

This isn't meant to be a typical review, but a true love letter. Not only for the care, which is part of a veterinarian's daily, relentless, and often underappreciated work, but for everything this clinic has meant to us.

This clinic, with all its specialists, welcomed my Wiz even in the most complicated situations we faced. It gave him refuge, but also to us, as a family. We found passion, empathy, and constant support, even beyond what would have been expected "professionally speaking," so much so that he was one of the few dogs happy to go to the vet, even though the treatments were anything but simple.

I would like to thank all of Dr. Pola's staff, without exception, but I feel the need to give a special mention to those who followed Wiz most closely and shared with us, step by step, this complex journey. To Dr. Chiara, for her attention, her presence, and the care with which she helped us on so many occasions. To Dr. Costanza, for her infinite sweetness, the gentleness, and the humanity with which she always approached Wiz and us.
To Denise, who was like a mother to us and to Wiz: always ready to listen patiently, to shower him with cuddles, attention, and celebrations, making him feel welcomed and loved every time.
And last but not least, to Dr. Melinda, who supported, advised, monitored, and pampered us every step of the way, from day one, with unprecedented professionalism and humanity. She was a constant point of reference for us, present even in the most difficult moments, always capable of combining expertise, clarity, gentleness, and a rare sensitivity. She knew how to care for Wiz not only as a patient, but as part of our family, accompanying us with care, respect, and love on a complex and delicate journey. In every decision, in every doubt, in every fear, we felt we were never alone, and this was of immense value to us.

We will never stop being grateful for allowing us to spend so much time with our Wiz. Unfortunately, he never got to thank you in words. But we will never stop: THANK YOU ♥️

Thank you so much for leaving us a 5-star review!
We're delighted to hear that you had a positive experience at our clinic. Every day, we work with passion and professionalism to ensure the best possible service for our patients and their owners. Kind regards,

Dear Mr. Grillo,
We sincerely thank you for taking the time to share your positive experience with our clinic.

We are truly happy to hear that our commitment, professionalism, and attention to our patients and their owners have been appreciated. Your feedback is a great motivation for us to continue offering attentive and quality service.

We remain at your disposal for any future needs.

Kind regards,
Certosa Veterinary Clinic
I brought my rabbit Macarena, the doctor was very kind and explained everything to me very patiently.

We and our Lio had a great time!
In addition to the professionalism and welcoming atmosphere, we also found people who truly love animals! Thanks to Flavia, who was amazing with our puppy!
Highly recommended
Thank you for your review, it encourages us to continue to put all our effort into caring for our little friends, who adore us without asking for anything.

Welcoming and competent. I finally solved my dog ​​Toto's gastrointestinal problem with a personalized diet designed by Dr. Costanza. A heartfelt thanks also to the precious Denise.

Cinzia G. and Toto
Excellent clinic, helpful and loving staff with my dog, who had no qualms about coming in for the first time. The doctors and nurses are truly top-notch!

My dog's spay/neuter appointment confirmed in writing via WhatsApp.
In the same conversation, I explicitly stated that we live in Switzerland and would be traveling to Italy specifically for this procedure, organizing travel, vacation, and a non-refundable hotel (€175).

A few days before the procedure, the clinic canceled everything at the last minute due to internal organizational issues. Unforeseen circumstances happen.
The subsequent handling, however, was simply unacceptable.

Dr. Aldo Giovanni Pola responded in an arrogant, defensive, and disrespectful tone, claiming:

"There is no contract"

"They are not required to know how clients reach the clinic"

and that "he has never heard of anything like this," completely downplaying the inconvenience and financial loss caused.

No assumption of responsibility.
No solution proposed.
No empathy.
Just an attempt to shift everything onto the client, as if a written confirmation of a medical service had no value.

Such behavior is unworthy of a facility that claims to be professional. It feels like someone who cancels, shrugs, and ends the conversation, with no respect for the time, organization, or costs incurred by pet owners.

A terrible experience.
This clinic is absolutely not recommended due to its arrogance, poor communication, and poor customer service.
The staff is excellent, professional, and incredibly empathetic. Our dog Olivia seems almost happy to come in. Highly recommended.
I had a great experience with Dr. Diotti. Melinda is very professional. She listens to patients and fixes problems. I recommend her.

I've known the clinic for years, and they've cared for all the cats I've owned, mostly former strays they've rescued and often FIV-positive. They've always done everything they could for everyone, with kindness and professionalism.

Excellent veterinary clinic, non-invasive non-surgical ear hematoma surgery. Furthermore, my dog ​​is not easy to manage, and the patience and resilience of Dr. Pola and his team ensured that sedation was not necessary. Thank you so much!
They help you in every way. They devote themselves to their patients beyond belief. They are passionate about their work and are conscientious, honest, and competent. I highly recommend them.

My Maine Coon, Lady, has been cared for here since last year. Last September, I brought her in for an emergency spay for the first time; they diagnosed her with early pyometra and saved her. We perform all her checkups and vaccinations at this clinic, and they recently saved her from an intestinal obstruction. Lady and I will make you saints. They are very knowledgeable, kind, empathetic with their furry little patients and their humans, and, last but not least, honest. Highly recommended.
It's been a long time since I've found a vet like this. The doctor and receptionists were professional, kind, and empathetic. Thank you!

Dear Caterina,

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We're happy to hear you had a positive experience at our clinic. The well-being of our four-legged patients is our priority, and we're happy to know our efforts were appreciated.

Best regards,
Certosa Veterinary Clinic Dr. Aldo Pola

Dear Mario,

Thank you so much for your 5-star review!
The well-being of our four-legged patients is our priority, and we're happy to know our commitment is appreciated.

Best regards,
Certosa Veterinary Clinic Dr. Aldo Pola

Dear Valentina,

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We're happy to hear you enjoyed your stay at our clinic. Your satisfaction is our priority and motivates us to continue offering the best possible service for our four-legged friends.

Best regards,
The team at Certosa Veterinary Clinic Dr. Aldo Pola
Thanks for the great review

Dear Irene,

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We're so happy to hear you had a positive experience at our clinic. The satisfaction of our clients and their four-legged friends is our top priority.

Best regards,
The team at Certosa Veterinary Clinic Dr. Aldo Pola
Super professional, very kind and always available to clarify any questions. Highly recommended!!!!!
Positive experience, I recommend it

Terrible experience.
I took my 9-year-old English bulldog for a diagnosis and subsequent treatment.
They had me undergo a physical examination, blood tests, urine tests, and an ultrasound for a total of €300, after which they demanded another blood test (another €100) to make a diagnosis.
I asked why this "additional" test wasn't recommended first, given that it's the only one that can diagnose the Cushing's syndrome they suspected.
The answer: "The protocol" establishes the schedule they impose.
In my humble opinion, the protocol is imposed by them to bill as much as possible. Ultimately, the doctor refused to prescribe the drug unless I took the additional test!
Their only interest is money.
What a disappointment!

On Monday, I stopped by to show a photo of something I found on one of my two cats: Chiara booked an appointment. Yesterday, I visited both cats with Dr. Flavia. Sara was there to pay. What can I say? Three competent professionals who were kind to both me and my furry friends. I'm awaiting the results of the exam, but I'm completely satisfied with both the service and the price. A heartfelt thank you ❤️ I highly recommend this center to anyone looking for professionals who can care for their furry friends with care and empathy.
Exceptional veterinary team. They are treating my cat with professionalism and love. They are always available for any advice or emergency. Thank you.

Bad experience some time ago, I took my dog ​​to the vet for an eye problem, he recommended eye drops, and "took advantage" of the visit to get further and unnecessary tests on the dog, costing 300 euros. 10 days later, Kira was back to square one with her eye problem. He should have recommended a specialist visit immediately and not "seize the opportunity" for unnecessary and expensive tests. I'm writing this review some time later, after having lost hope in vets, now that Kira has a more serious problem and I delayed taking her to a vet because I can't trust any of them after this experience.
He saved our Amstaff Thiago from severe hip dysplasia, which would have quickly made him unable to walk. He underwent surgery 10 years ago and has always moved normally and lives a happy life.

Great experience! I recommend this clinic to everyone: kindness, sweetness, thoughtfulness, and care. My super-scary dog ​​has found her place: she comes in feeling calm, after a previous experience of terror. A special thanks to Dr. Patrizia, who with her sweetness has been able to relate to Summer! Thanks also to the dermatologist and nutritionist who is treating her with scrupulous care! Every little detail is explained to us humans! Of course, thanks for the hospitality and for being there, also to Denise, who always welcomes us with a big smile! Highly recommended!!!!!!
Thanks Elisa.

I've been taking them for many years, first with my cat,
now with my dog, I've always had a great experience, everyone is professional and kind. Thank you.
We went to the clinic with our dog for an orthopedic consultation/checkup. The entire staff was very friendly, and the doctor explained everything to us thoroughly—we're very satisfied :-)
After going through 3 vets, we finally found them for my 3 cats. They're truly professional, responsible, kind, polite, and good at their jobs. Thank you so much ❤️
Very kind and competent staff. I recommend this clinic to everyone!

My dog ​​is named Kidd, an 11-year-old Bolognese. Since he was 3 months old, he has been treated wonderfully by Dr. Pola's Veterinary Clinic. I've moved out of Milan, but I wouldn't replace Dr. Pola's Veterinary Clinic with anything else. The entire medical team offers true professionalism, care, and helpfulness. For me, they represent excellence for our pets. I have complete trust.
Thank you for your review, best regards, Casper, and see you soon!
I'm finding it great, they're keeping my personal hygiene under control, very available.
Thanks for your review!
Excellent experience, I thank all the staff for the empathy shown towards my cat
